theme_strategy.vibe: Elite precision, analytical, trustworthy but modern. Deep dark backgrounds with high-visibility kinetic triggers for data (think Vercel/Linear dashboards). No generic SaaS blue or purple.
theme_strategy.general_rules: Avoid generic 'Bootstrap' symmetry. Prioritize extreme data legibility with dense, grid-based layouts. Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays.

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Establish tension through contrasting geometric and monospace typefaces.

headings.usage: Use tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers to ensure a sharp, dense look.

body.usage: Crisp and highly legible for long form text and dense tables.

metrics_and_scores.usage: Use strictly for the Virality Score numbers, deltas (Prediction vs Reality), and data labels.

colors.rules: Zero full-screen gradients. Tint grays slightly cool. Hover state text must always be explicitly set. Avoid Teal Green (#1B93A4) and Purple (#7351B7).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (The Technical Look) for the Analytics Dashboard. 1px solid strokes (border-white/10). No soft muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating overlays: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-2xl and a 1px top border of border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle CSS noise/grain on the Launch Twin generation backdrop to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.chart_styles: Use sharp line charts and crisp bar charts (Recharts). Remove default grid lines; keep only horizontal reference lines at 10% opacity.

grids_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) for the Dashboard and Analytics.
grids_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding inside containers (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision with borders. Use gap-4 or gap-6 for metric bento boxes.
grids_layouts.bento_spans: Summary metrics (col-span-1), Main Chart (col-span-2 row-span-2), Feed/History (col-span-1 row-span-2).

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast (bg-white text-black for primary). Must include hover:scale-[0.98] and active:scale-95 micro-animations.
component_instructions.cards: Flat background, max 8px border-radius. 1px subtle border (border-white/10). Hover effect should slightly lift or highlight the border (hover:border-white/20).
component_instructions.virality_score_display: Do not just use a circle. Use horizontal layered bars or 'segmented chips' for hook, clarity, emotion, and shareability. Add text reasoning beside each factor.
component_instructions.prediction_vs_reality: Display as a split-pane or side-by-side metric box. Use JetBrains Mono for the delta. Highlight positive delta in Acid Yellow (#D3FF24).
component_instructions.forms_inputs: Shadcn based. Dark background, 1px border. Focus ring should be high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/50).

motion.rules: No 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
motion.interactions: Buttons/cards scale down slightly on click. Rows in the Leaderboard or Campaign History should stagger in using framer-motion.
motion.data_reveal: Use count-up animations for the Virality Score and prediction deltas.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap heavy animations in a check for prefers-reduced-motion.

media_images.rules: No placeholder images. Use provided realistic imagery for demo users or atmospheric backgrounds.

user_avatar.description: Professional avatar for Audience DNA profiles / User account.

abstract_tech_texture.description: Neon/Geometric abstract texture. Can be used at low opacity (10-15%) for empty states or the background of the Shareable Report.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Use text-shadow on text overlapping any textured backgrounds.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, score chips, run campaign button) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="run-campaign-button"`).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus states with higher contrast than the default state.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (default for Shadcn) or @phosphor-icons/react for duotone tech feel.
libraries.animation: framer-motion (for layout shifts, staggering list items, and number tickers).
libraries.notifications: sonner (standardize for prediction updates, campaign run success).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the 'AI slop' aesthetic by ensuring strict geometric alignment, sharp contrasts, and omitting unnecessary gradients.
Never apply `transition: all` in CSS. Always target specific properties like `opacity` or `transform`.
Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Left-align dense data for readability.
Always use the provided actual image URLs. Never use generic placeholder services.
Prioritize using existing UI components in `/src/components/ui/` before building custom raw HTML inputs.
For the Virality Score, ensure the formula explanation is visually prominent, not hidden behind tooltips. Show the math.
Data-testid attributes are MANDATORY on all clickable or state-changing elements for reliable testing.
